meta.method: web research via DuckDuckGo HTML + Bing endpoints, ~15 fetch cap
meta.confidence_notes: Fields marked 'unverified' need local confirming; all others trace to cited URLs.

operators.name: Greater Amman Municipality (GAM / أمانة عمان الكبرى) — Traffic Directorate of GAM
operators.scope: Within Amman city limits (avg-speed corridors, speed radars, red-light/traffic-light cameras, AI seatbelt+phone cameras)
facts: Apr 2026: new integrated system activated — 9 point-to-point average-speed measuring corridors (shaped on Airport Street AND Jordan Street), 20 traffic-light cameras, 21 speed radars (counts vary slightly across GAM statements: another statement says 20 radars); fully operational by Apr 28 2026 [khaberni 801147, Al-Mamlaka via GAM spokesman Nasser Rahamneh]
Overall program: 5,500 cameras by end of 2026 ('Smart Amman' vision) [garaanews 404026]

History: 19 speed cameras activated 2017-2018 after 4-month trial (Al-Irsal/Hadi Mosque, Marj Al Hamam...); second phase 22 cameras incl. 12 at street sides & traffic lights [royanews 13145; media.ammancity.gov.jo]
AI cameras flag phone use + no seatbelt, from ~2025: 11 cameras then, now expanding [ammanvoice 85501; royanews 67689]
Locations chosen from accident/dangerous-violation studies; signed 'warning before monitored zone' [thisisamman 16398; khaberni]

operators.name: Central Traffic Directorate / Public Security Directorate (إدارة السير المركزية — الأمن العام)
operators.scope: Kingdom-wide: desert highway + intercity radars, CCTV network, checkpoints, patrol cars
facts: PSD stated ~2,500 CCTV cameras across Jordan's streets, with AI + drones used in traffic management [jonews24]
AI systems branded in Jordanian press as 'عين الصقر' (Eagle Eye) for violation detection [royanews 389389]
External Patrol Directorate (إدارة الدوريات الخارجية) does intercity speed enforcement; caught cars at 200-203 km/h on Zarqa-Azraq road vs 100 km/h posted [addustour 1593359]
Fixed radars also inside Zarqa corridor operated by CTD/related bodies; new cameras announced one-by-one via radio/social traffic alerts

operators.name: Vendor: Traffic Tech (traffic-tech.jo)
operators.scope: Private Jordanian integrator 'pioneer in traffic enforcement technology in Jordan' — installs radars & speed cameras for authorities

camera_types_in_use: Fixed spot-speed radar cameras (urban + intercity posts on poles near crossings/descents)
Average-speed point-to-point corridors (ينبغي تنبيه double-read; currently Amman-only: 9 corridors on Airport St & Jordan St) — defeats brake-at-radar trick
Red-light / traffic-light cameras at signalized intersections (~20 in 2026 phase)
AI-looking cameras for phone & seatbelt (Applies over multiple lanes)
Mobile radar vans/check points (patrols, rotating) — anecdotal; stationary-checkpoint culture remains strong
CCTV surveillance (2,500 cameras PSD-wide, mostly not automated enforcement)
cameras.gatso_or_other_brand: No source found identifying Gatso or any specific brand in Jordan. Vendors include Traffic Tech; press calls systems 'smart radars'/'smart cameras'. Treat brand as unverified.
violations_enforced: illegal stopping / parking on pedestrian crossings
mobile-phone use while driving (JD 50 fine per bestroadtrip) [https://bestroadtrip.com/driving-in/jordan]

unauthorized modifications (Europcar summary of Traffic Law: 'danger alert or multi-sounds for unauthorized vehicles', subwoofer, body additions) [https://www.europcar.jo/pages/jordan-traffic-law-and-fines]

speed_limits_aggregated.amman_ring_and_main_streets: 60-80 typical; specific corridor 70 km/h noted round 'المقابلين' radar [garaanews]
speed_limits_aggregated.amman_zarqa_highway: High-quality dual carriageway; adjacent Zarqa-Azraq road posted 100 [addustour 1593359]. Amman-Zarqa specifics (60 vs 80 vs 100) not directly sourced — verify per-segment on ground.
speed_limits_aggregated.dead_sea_highway_road65: Not directly sourced; gentle descents + sharp village entries; norm for similar Jordanian roads ~80-100. Verify with SIGNS on the ground.
speed_limits_aggregated.desert_highway_amman_aqaba_r15: 120 [multiple: internationaldriverlicence.org 'Desert Highway 120 km/h'; nostosroute 'top speed 110 on Desert Highway' (conflicts — one says 110)]
resting_notes: NostosRoute: unmarked speed bumps appear at edge of nearly every village on Desert Highway and King's Highway — accounts for 'rumble' driver fear on Dead Sea/King's road [https://nostosroute.com/international-driving-guide/jordan]
One toll road exists; bestroadtrip mentions single toll road + Aqaba customs stop at city entry [bestroadtrip]

Airport Rd Landmark Hotel descent (النزول) — radar both directions [garaanews]
خلدا: right after the tunnel toward Hussein Gardens [garaanews]
شارع متصاشل ياجوز: after Special Forces bridge, before tank-command entrance [garaanews]
المقابلين (Mutq'a-lin): across from Sobhi Abu Ghalous BLDG; 70 km/h [garaanews]
دا بو (Dabouq): after Nesr signal toward 'Al-Bakaloria' [garaanews]
بيادر وادي السير: after UNRWA BLDG (first Abu Al-Sous descent) [garaanews]
شارع مكة: after Makka Mall toward Shabab circle [garaanews]
شارع الجاردنز: after Jabri signal toward Oasis Circle [garaanews]
شارع المطل: from Qreiqaish circle to Al-Yasmeen [garaanews]
طريق السلط: after Umm Al-Na'aj bridge toward Amman [garaanews]
وسط البلد: after Mabrouk bridge toward Reghadan [garaanews]
Legacy 2017-18 19-camera cluster incl. Al-Irsal traffic lights (Hadi Mosque), Marj Al Hamam lights [royanews 13145]
zarqa_corridor: Amman-Zarqa 'Autosterad' road: NEW speed cams — near 'Kazia Sherim' (كازية شريم) toward Amman [nabd 154899232, Instagram reel 2025]; another fresh camera alert on Amman-Zarqa [facebook/husna.news video]
Zarqa-Azraq road: 100 km/h posted; drivers caught at 200-203 by External Patrols [addustour 1593359]
other_intercity: Desert Highway R15 (Amman-Ma'an-Aqaba): 110-120 km/h, straight fast south route [viamo; jordan-spirit]; village-edge unmarked speed bumps; police checkpoints along route
Dead Sea Highway (Road 65): steep, hairpin, village edges with speed bumps — 'rumble' reputation among drivers (qualitative; not camera-dense from this research)
Aqaba: customs/police checkpoint at city entry [bestroadtrip]
Irbid & Ajloun & north (Route 35 corridor): urban 50-60 enforcement, no corridor count sourced
crowd_sourced_alert_culture: Jordanian radio + FB pages post per-day 'new camera here' alerts (Husna FM, Nabd reposts) — proof of appetite the app should digitize [people's video links above]
GAM itself says locations are 'announced with very clear addresses' to maximize compliance, not trick — supports an official location-list pairing [khaberni]

official.jordan: No public GeoJSON/CSV of camera sites found. GAM announces via press lists (street-level text), and on amman.jo eServices pages.
official.darak: Unverified — not researched in depth; check separate police app for report features.

osm.query_attempt: Overpass count of highway=speed_camera + enforcement=maxspeed in Jordan bbox returned HTTP 406 (blocked from this fetcher) — count not obtained; do an OSM-tag audit in JOSM/Overpass-Turbo directly.
osm.practical: OSM Jordan urban roads are increasingly complete on主干 streets; enforcement nodes sparse. Building a Jordan camera DB will require: press-list scraping (garaanews-style articles annual), radio/FB crowd alerts, community verification campaign (JOSM + app-side 'confirm/deny' flow).

PhotoEnforced has a Jordan page (aggregated red-light/speed listings, quality unknown) [https://www.photoenforced.com/Jordan.html]

Waze — heavy in Amman driving scene (routes around radar/checkpoints; community comments/pop counts unverified here) [described for Arab world: aramobi.com Waze guide]
Radarbot (Radarbot كاشف الرادارات '(ساهر)') — Arab-localized speed camera/speed limit alert app, distributed on APKPure + App Store [apkpure/net/ar; apps.apple.com/sa id1099797635]
Speed Camera Radar (gvluky) — available in region stores (generic; unverified usage)
data_sources.productized_gap: No Jordan-local camera/speed app surfaced in searches; local flavor is ceded to global apps + radio/FB alerts. That IS the market.

market.currency: JOD (JD); USD 1 ≈ 0.71 JD; fines scale JD ~20-75+ (JD 50 for phone [bestroadtrip])
market.price_sensitivity: high for subscriptions; sub-JD 1.4 one-off IAP acceptable; APKfree/Radarbot-APKPure presence signals piracy/sideload workaround culture [apkpure]

payments.google_play: Google Wallet supported in Jordan — cards via AJIB (min balance JOD 5 + online-shopping limit toggle), Al Rajhi Jordan, other jordanean banks [support.google.com/wallet/answer/12059326 (co=GENIE.CountryCode=JO); ajib.com/google-pay; alrajhibank.com.jo/en/google-pay]
payments.apple: Apple Pay live with Capital Bank, Jordan Commercial Bank (Tejari Pay) [capitalbank.jo; jcbank.com.jo/en/apple-pay]; Apple account payment methods page applies [support.apple.com/en-us/111741]
payments.implication: IAP works for carded users; but expect ~big share needing voucher/sideload/forF distribution (telecom carriers Zain/Umniah/Orange-JO) — unverified in this burst, design for it.

market.app_store_environment: Jordan localized Play listing (hl=ar&gl=JO examples), categories trending in searches: news (Roya, Khaberni, Nabd), payments (Tejari Pay), shopping/wallet; careem & delivery omnipresent (qualitative).
media_channels: Radio (Husna FM etc.) publishes new-camera alerts by phone-in — the native channel for the community-report mechanic
Facebook news pages dominate local traffic info (videos of new camera installs get engagement)
fan_positions: 'Smart Amman' narrative: officials deny 'جباية' (revenue-harvest) intent, emphasize safety ('أمن وليس جباية') [garaanews 404026]

Privacy/legal debate on AI cameras looking INTO vehicles (phone/seatbelt) предваряется by legal commentators declaring some types 'unconstitutional' claims [nabd 153037435; aldarnews 76676] — maintaining moderate positioning instead of 'beat the fuzz' helps

aa_flags: 'مخطاف' — common Amman slang for speed camera / radar post (heard broadly; dictionary trace not found in this research — verify with local reviewers before shipping tattoos/aggressive copy)
'تقليعة' variant spelling; 'خفة' light-footed driving; 'عكر وجه' to nokpout someone
Street names live in 'فولتارشو' style menus: شارع المطار (Airport St), الأوتوستراد (Autosterad, the Amman-Zarqa), الحزام، الدورات (circles), رمثا/اربد points
dialect.careful: Dialect entries above include items not directly verified in fetched sources; treat as 'local-flavor hypothesis requiring native review' except those sourced from the fetched articles (route names, 'كازية', 'الدورات', 'أوتوستراد', 'كتاب' بlegislative citations).

legal.radar_detector_hardware: Grey zone: no criminal offense, possession not (clearly) illegal, but device may be seized; approximate fine 50-150 EUR; enforcement level 'lax'. GPS-based camera-alert apps are legal. Laser jammers illegal. [Fuel prices.eu Jordan page — USE AS indicative, not statute: https://www.fuel-prices.eu/radar-detector-laws/jordan/]
legal.camera_alert_apps: Legal; no Jordanian statute surfaced restricting community reporting of checkpoints/cameras. Waze-style reporting remains widespread in region.
traffic_law_enforcement_notes: Posting of limits + warning signs before zones is a legal ceremony GAM emphasizes (forewarn = compliance) [thisisamman; khaberni] — app mirror: give 1-2 km pre-warning to build goodwill

Vehicle mods incl. unauthorized sound/devices already Criminal-adjacent via Traffic Law ['add unauthorized illegal options to body', 'danger alert/multi-sounds' Europcar summary] — keep feature integration to GPS-based alerting to stay clean
AI camera privacy debate active — product copy should champion safety + fairness, not 'beating the radar'
ja_app_constraints: Do NOT ship laser jammer features
Prefer OSM-style attribution + community confirm flow over scraped commercial DB
Certificate of legitimacy: cite official fine-inquiry channels (102 / amman.jo) for value-add (violation status screen)
